canonical_game_context.root_cause: Production Worker reaches the canonical ESPN scoreboard request but receives upstream HTTP 403. Physical evidence proves the app/worker failure-provenance contract is correct; parser/mapping is not the blocking defect.

team_total.bounded_repair: Only after schedule/event IDs are reliably available, validate one approved ESPN odds provider policy, same-event total+spread, timestamp/freshness and side orientation, then call the existing impliedTeamTotal helper. No synthetic totals from projections.

weather_opponent.root_cause: Opponent, kickoff, venue/roof and event weather depend on complete canonical game-context events. Upstream schedule 403 therefore blocks the lane. Weather additionally remains fail-closed unless a fresh event-bound forecast is present.
weather_opponent.bounded_repair: Restore verified game context first; retain existing fresh-event weather requirements and no-weather-needed dome semantics.
